correctness.rationale: Each diagonal vertex requires at least one selected vertex in its row, and each selected vertex has m-t unselected clique neighbours, forcing t>=m-k. Symmetric circulant binary matrices realize the lower bound. Equality saturation forces transposition symmetry along every link. Conversely symmetry ensures exact feasibility. Independent exhaustive direct graph enumeration through m=4 and symmetric-matrix tests through m=6 confirmed all stated finite cases; the general proof is not inferred from these computations.

value.rationale: The work proves an entire depth-two stratum of a freshly posed Sierpiński limited-domination conjecture, and refines size to full optimal-set classification. The symmetric matrix model provides all-parameter exact coefficients and structural involution/path-cycle enumerations and a nontrivial complement duality, useful for exact finite counting and comparisons in general depths.
